messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
Which items must a distributor check before making a machine (not partly completed machinery) available on the market on 1 March 2027, according to the act that is in force on that day?

response.text: Quali elementi deve verificare un distributore prima di mettere a disposizione sul mercato una macchina (non quasi-macchina) il 1 marzo 2027, secondo l'atto in vigore in tale data?
